ZMB.note: Digital skills appear only as an aim of the regional strategy; no programme for the public stated.

facts.fact: COMESA reports that Zambia hosted, with World Bank support, the 3-5 November 2026 Lusaka workshop at which 15 member states validated the Regional Digital Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan.
